We need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 6 steps, leaves commercially available, total price <= $9999. Need to construct route using available precursors.

Target: O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O

Let's parse: It's a sulfonamide linking an aniline (aryl) to a heterocycle? Actually sulfonyl attached to N of an aniline (aryl sulfonamide). The sulfonyl also attached to a fluorophenyl (para-F). So sulfonyl group: SO2 attached to N (sulfonamide) and to aryl (fluorophenyl). The N attached to aromatic ring (aryl) which also has a substituent: N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2 (a tertiary amine with carbamate). Also fused bicyclic ring: C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3) attached to aromatic.

So we can think of disconnection: sulfonyl chloride + aniline (aryl amine) to form sulfonamide. So we can get sulfonyl chloride from fluorophenyl sulfonyl chloride (4-fluorobenzenesulfonyl chloride). That's commercially available? Likely yes. Search.
